---
title: Links
---

Link sanitization covers scheme restrictions and `target="_blank"` hardening.
The author can write markdown links, raw HTML links, and URLs to various
schemes — the sanitizer decides which survive.

Padding: the sanitizer exists because feed content is rendered by many
different clients, some of which follow links eagerly (preview fetches,
link unfurling) or honor `target` in ways that can leak referrer data.
Forcing `rel="noopener noreferrer"` on any `target="_blank"` link closes
the referrer and prevents `window.opener` abuse on clients that do open
new tabs. The `rel` change is idempotent.

## Safe schemes

Plain external link: [Example](https://example.org/one)

Email: <a href="mailto:editor@example.org">editor@example.org</a>

Phone: <a href="tel:+15555551212">+1-555-555-1212</a>

## target=\_blank hardening

<a href="https://external.example/" target="_blank">
  opens in new tab
</a>

<a href="https://another.example/" target="_blank" rel="author">
  opens with existing rel
</a>

## Unsafe schemes

<a href="javascript:alert(1)">js scheme</a>

<a href="data:text/html,<script>alert(1)</script>">data html</a>

<a href="file:///etc/passwd">file scheme</a>

<a href="vbscript:msgbox(1)">vbscript</a>

Trailing paragraph so the body has substance.
